title: The rare articulations: staccatissimo, stress, unstress, soft accent
description: Four identical quarter-note C5s, each carrying one of the four less-common event markings the renderer draws: staccatissimo (the wedge-dot), stress, unstress, and soft accent. The spec mirror covers the everyday four (staccato, accent, tenuto, strong accent); this scenario completes the drawn set so every rendered marking glyph has a golden.
